subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close after a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb lands, or should closure require a broader live-target/switcher identity surface?
rationale: Current main lacks workspace header context, the focused closing PR is open but conflicting, and another open UI PR removes the breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard header product contract.

options.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Rebase and land the focused workspace breadcrumb, then close this issue while tracking optional switcher, prefix, color, and stronger live-target proof ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Keep this issue open until the implementation also proves switch feedback, reload/reconnect target identity, and the live writable target tuple from the discussion.

options.title: Replace Header Surface
options.body: If the no-breadcrumb direction wins, require another persistent in-chat target indicator before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Rebase and land the focused workspace breadcrumb, then close this issue while tracking optional switcher, prefix, color, and stronger live-target proof ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent UI refactors own the current Dashboard header/app-shell surface that needs the product-direction decision applied.
